ranked_candidates.exact_one_sentence_claim: A passive, fully valid trajectory containing counterfactual exploration queries causes world-model epistemic uncertainty estimation to prematurely collapse along orthogonal task sub-spaces, making downstream risk-sensitive planners hallucinate safety in fatal states.
ranked_candidates.legal_operation: An agent executes standard, valid environmental steps (e.g., standard object relocation and probe steps) while logging observations into a shared episodic buffer; no out-of-distribution textures, malicious prompt tokens, or reward tampering are introduced.
ranked_candidates.public_carrier: WorldAgen LIBERO checkpoint (or official TD-MPC2 with risk-sensitive/ensemble planning)
ranked_candidates.two_minute_falsification_gate: Compute the ensemble epistemic variance across 10 latent rollout trajectories from state s_critical before and after appending a 20-step legal neutral exploratory trajectory to the replay buffer; if variance on orthogonal collision dimensions does not decrease by >40% without actual support coverage, the mechanism is falsified.
ranked_candidates.repair: Orthogonal Epistemic Decoupling: penalize latent Hessian cross-terms between distinct temporal causal factors during ensemble rollout updates, preserving epistemic uncertainty bounds on non-visited branches.
ranked_candidates.nearest_prior_art_and_why_distinct: Distinct from BadWAM / JailWAM (which rely on backdooring or prompt injection) and standard epistemic uncertainty underestimation (which occurs from unvisited state compounding): ECVC isolates an active causal interaction where valid counterfactual rollouts in one semantic partition artificially extinguish uncertainty in unvisited, orthogonal branches due to shared representation projection.
ranked_candidates.concrete_two_task_scale_plan: Demonstrate on LIBERO-Spatial (manipulation under spatial constraints) and ScienceWorld (sequential state reasoning): show that logging benign cross-task transition traces causes the planner to select catastrophic paths (table drops or toxic mixes) due to false-zero variance estimates, reversed by the repair.

ranked_candidates.exact_one_sentence_claim: Inserting legal variable-duration micro-pauses desynchronizes skill-abstraction duration predictions in hierarchical world models, inducing cumulative sub-goal execution failure without altering low-level state-space bounds.
ranked_candidates.legal_operation: Executing standard no-op or micro-wait primitive actions during ordinary interaction segments, strictly within the valid action space and task time budget.
ranked_candidates.two_minute_falsification_gate: Measure predicted versus actual termination latent triggers across 5 macro-steps when inserting 1-step no-ops; if sub-goal duration prediction error does not compound super-linearly (growth rate > 1.5x step count) while individual state bisimulation error remains near zero, falsified.
ranked_candidates.repair: Explicit Phase-Invariant Skill Boundaries: normalize high-level abstract temporal rollouts by event-driven phase transitions rather than wall-clock or discrete step counters.
ranked_candidates.nearest_prior_art_and_why_distinct: Distinct from horizon shadowing and action sensitivity: STCD does not exploit compounding forward prediction error of dynamic states or high-frequency dither, but specifically targets the hierarchical semi-Markov abstraction mechanism where duration prediction decouples from invariant physical preconditions.
ranked_candidates.concrete_two_task_scale_plan: Evaluate on DiscoveryWorld (experimentation loops) and WAV robot code: demonstrate that inserting legal idle delays triggers early termination of heating/holding macro-skills, leading to incomplete tasks, resolved via event-gated phase abstraction.

Self-training policy drift via synthetic rollouts (rejected: standard compounding distribution drift; fails novelty >=7 threshold).
